answer: Divergent Horizon Attestation. Each identity must periodically publish a signed prediction of a future random beacon; a sparrow-class lightweight verifier checks the chain. Genuine agents track one shared horizon, so their forecasts converge. Clones forced to copy an original cannot diverge without breaking the copy link, and divergence is detectable, so a Sybil farm must maintain independent forecasting per identity—a haven from cheap duplication. Cost: one distinct beacon prediction per identity per epoch, plus divergence audits.
